headline: DBM Releases ₱1.855 Billion in Additional Funding for Philippine General Hospital
seoTitle: DBM Releases ₱1.855B Additional Funds for PGH | FMB News
seoDescription: The DBM released ₱1.855 billion in additional funding for Philippine General Hospital to expand patient assistance and support facility upgrades.
deck: The fresh allocation is intended to strengthen patient assistance, equipment modernization and hospital readiness.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Budget and Management approved the release of ₱1.855 billion in additional funding to the Philippine General Hospital, according to the approved FMB News morning brief.
The package says the funds will support medical assistance for indigent and financially constrained patients, diagnostic equipment, intensive care modernization and essential medicine stocks.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: PGH is the country's largest national university hospital and a major referral center for complex cases. The funding release comes as hospitals also prepare for post-flood increases in illnesses such as leptospirosis and dengue.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Additional resources can help the hospital absorb patient surges while sustaining subsidized care for people who cannot afford full treatment costs.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for DBM and PGH implementation notices detailing procurement, patient-assistance expansion and the timetable for facility upgrades.
